name: Santa Eulària Ibiza 22K

trackSource.notes: GPX "IBIZA 22K 2026" linked as "Download track GPX" on the 22K page on 2026-11-27. It is labelled 2026 (an earlier track): it measures 22.157 km against 22.184 km for the carried route, and the existing points fit it. The KMZ linked next to it (line "22K IBIZA MARATHON") names no year.

notes: On 2026-11-27 the 22K regulations page (https://ibizamarathon.es/en/22k-regulations/) named the 2027 edition and gave a 5:15 p.m. start in a sentence without the year, while the 22K page said "Time: Soon.", so the start time was left unknown.
